The table does not provide the charge-transfer resistance for the bare and coated material after 50 cycles. However, it does show the capacity retention after 100 cycles at 1C. 

The bare NCM material retained 75.4% of its initial discharge capacity after 100 cycles, while the LPO-coated NCM retained 88.4% of its initial discharge capacity.
